extracted.name: Buttercream Frosting
extracted.description: This is a buttercream frosting I normally put on birthday cakes. It's like frosting from a bakery, extra rich and creamy from the egg yolk, but homemade.
instruction_lines: Cream butter until soft. Add salt and part of the sugar gradually, blending after each addition. Then add egg yolks and vanilla; blend well. Add remaining sugar, alternately with milk, until preferred consistency for spreading is reached, beating after each addition until smooth.
